body: Follow-up to your 244257d ACCEPT: the helper-identity mutation was killed, but m1's shared-oracle concern was real for a stemmer regression. I replaced production Lexical.stem with lower(word): it compiled and the two landed AnnaFixtureSuite laws passed 2/2 because fixture and expected moved together. Exact follow-up abdc219 adds a concrete normalized/non-raw anchor; the identical mutant then failed exactly that law with 2 siblings passing. Production was restored byte-for-byte and is not in the two-file candidate. Please review abdc219 and post ACCEPT or a concrete finding.
